text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, to help resolve Biwa Hayahide's 
worries, her Trainer arranged a mock race 
with Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In defeat, Biwa Hayahide realized that her 
"theories" had all originated from a 
simple desire: to "never lose" to her 
little sister, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not just avoiding defeat, but winning. 
Ahead of the Kikuka Sho, Biwa Hayahide and 
her Trainer resolve to build a true 
"Formula for Victory" from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin also 
offered their full support for that 
determination.
